experiment: VLM Model Selection for Tier 2 Cross-Model OOD Validator
objective: Select the best VLM for Tier 2 cross-model agreement scoring in the OOD detection pipeline for SigLIP2-IQA document quality assessment.

synthetic_poc.subset_composition: 3 in-distribution + 7 OOD (tibetan, myanmar, ethiopic, pristine, degraded, low_dpi, high_dpi)
synthetic_poc.ground_truth: Synthetic MOS scores from generation parameters

diqa5000.description: DIQA-5000 train split (real document photos with human MOS)
diqa5000.ground_truth: Human MOS from 15 scorers (overall, sharpness, color_fidelity)

qwen3.5-27b.note: NOT a dedicated vision model — poor vision performance

gemini-flash-lite.note: Binary output only (excellent/poor) — no mid-range discrimination

gemini-flash-image.note: Constant 'excellent' for sharpness on all images

grok-4.1-fast.note: HALLUCINATING — rates degraded images as excellent

qwen3.5-flash.note: Wastes 3K+ reasoning tokens per image, internally contradictory

kimi-k2.5.note: 0% parse rate — all responses null (reasoning exhausts max_tokens)

prompting_strategy.description: 3 separate prompts, one per dimension (overall, sharpness, color)

prompt_template.overall: Rate the overall quality of this document image. Consider readability, clarity, and general visual quality. Choose exactly one: excellent, good, fair, poor, or bad. Respond with only one word.
prompt_template.sharpness: Rate the sharpness quality of this document image. Consider text clarity, edge definition, and focus. Choose exactly one: excellent, good, fair, poor, or bad. Respond with only one word.
prompt_template.color: Rate the color fidelity of this document image. Consider color accuracy, saturation, and consistency. Choose exactly one: excellent, good, fair, poor, or bad. Respond with only one word.

rationale: Best balanced SRCC across all 3 dimensions on both synthetic and real data
100% parse rate — always returns clean single-word responses
13x faster than qwen3.5-27b, 9x faster than reasoning models
Purpose-built vision model (not text-model with bolted-on vision)

rejected_models.qwen3.5-27b: Not a vision model, inconsistent dimensions, very slow
rejected_models.kimi-k2.5: Cannot produce content within 32 tokens (reasoning model)
